parole.motivo_incerta: Of uncertain origin; Possibly; perhaps; modello unc/uncertain
parole.significato: Soil formed of dead but not fully decayed plants found in bog areas, often burned as fuel.
parole.testo: Inherited from Northern Middle English pete (recorded in Latin text as peta), of uncertain origin; perhaps from a Celtic language such as an unattested Pictish or Brythonic source, in turn possibly from Proto-Brythonic *peθ (“portion, segment, piece”); if so, it would be a doublet of piece.
